title: Anthropic Claude Design AI visual canvas in research preview
summary: Anthropic released Claude Design, a research-preview design tool powered by Claude Opus 4.7 that generates slides, prototypes, landing pages and marketing graphics from natural-language descriptions. Outputs can be refined via chat, comments, direct edits or sliders, and exports include ZIP, PDF, standalone HTML, Canva and hand-off to Claude Code. Available to paid Claude users at launch.

web_findings.title: Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
web_findings.snippet: Research-preview workspace powered by Opus 4.7 for visual prototyping; available to Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise subscribers.

web_findings.title: Anthropic just launched Claude Design
web_findings.snippet: Released 17 April 2026; positioned as complement to Figma and Canva with handoff to both.

web_findings.title: Get started with Claude Design
web_findings.snippet: Onboarding builds a design system from a codebase or design files.
